visual: Small, dense, bushy evergreen shrub with an upright habit and unusually tiny dark green leaves neatly margined creamy white, creating a fine-textured variegated appearance.
soil: Any soil, well-drained; Avoid waterlogging; shade dulls the cream
prune: Prune as required to maintain shape and density. Remove damaged, reverted or unwanted shoots.
resilience: Hardy, evergreen and tolerant of a wide range of soils and aspects once established.
uses: Low hedging, edging, containers, courtyard gardens, coastal gardens, ground cover and mixed borders.
toxicity: Harmful if eaten. Wear gloves and protective equipment when handling.
hardinessNote: Hardy in most places throughout the UK, approximately -15 to -10°C.
